description: Play Prince Lytton of Melbourne, modern nights. Hold praxis since 1888. Keep the Masquerade. Keep the Cress Truce. A Vampire: The Masquerade grand-strategy scenario built on the Open Historia engine (MIT) — the Truce renewal is imminent, Sarrasine's agents stir in the eastern suburbs, Hardacre's file grows thicker, and the Beckoning is pulling you north.
heroSubtitle: Hold praxis. Keep the Truce. Survive your own city.
name: Melbourne by Night
subtitle: VtM — modern nights, March 2026
